_readme: Legal numbers live HERE, not in code. When a notification changes, edit this file only. The risk engine warns when today's date is past valid_to, so a stale wage floor can never silently produce a wrong verdict.

minimum_wage_mp_general.revised: twice a year (1 April and 1 October)
minimum_wage_mp_general.schedule: Single statewide schedule - Madhya Pradesh has no zones (resolves the earlier zone A/B/C question).
minimum_wage_mp_general.notification_cited: Labour Commissioner, Madhya Pradesh (Indore): VDA order dated 30 Sep 2026 (notification no. 22288-337, as cited by getsleet.cloud) on the basic rates of notification F.4(B)1/2014/A-16 dated 4 Mar 2024.
minimum_wage_mp_general.how_to_verify: Open the notification listed under 'Minimum Wages' on labour.mponline.gov.in (Hindi PDF) and confirm unskilled = 12,575/month. Then change verification_status to VERIFIED_FROM_OFFICIAL_NOTIFICATION.

agricultural_schedule.note: MP lists agricultural employment separately. The Apr-Sep 2026 research found a LOWER VDA for agricultural workers (Rs 2,352 vs Rs 2,850 per month). The Oct 2026 agricultural figure was not found. Until it is, the engine treats a below-floor wage in a farm context as 'medium - verify', never as a confirmed violation.
